prompt: place these countries in order from north to south: Lesotho, Rwanda, Morocco, Spain, Sweden, Poland, Austria
response:
Here are the countries listed in order from north to south:

1. Sweden (located in Northern Europe)
2. Poland (located in Central Europe, south of Sweden)
3. Austria (located in Central Europe, south of Poland)
4. Spain (located in Southern Europe, on the Iberian Peninsula)
5. Morocco (located in North Africa, north of Lesotho and Rwanda)
6. Lesotho (located in Southern Africa, completely surrounded by South Africa)
7. Rwanda (located in Central Africa, south of Morocco and east of the Democratic Republic of Congo)

Note: The order might seem a bit unusual because Morocco is geographically south of Spain across the Mediterranean Sea, but in terms of direct north-south positioning on the Earth's surface, Morocco is north of Lesotho and Rwanda.
